The '''Golden Mask''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by [[Hoes|digging]] up [[Artifact Spot]]s in [[the Desert]]. It also has a chance to appear inside [[Artifact Trove]]s.

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Gifting==
{{GiftsByItem

}} 
 
==Bundles==
The Golden Mask is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
The Golden Mask is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Golden Mask (hat)|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
The Golden Mask is not used in any [[quests]].
  
==Trivia==
The Golden Mask might be a reference to the Stone Mask from [[wikipedia:Battle Tendency|JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Battle Tendency]], as the two both have a large gemstone near the top.
